parameters.jsCode:
const d = $json;

const clinicalText = [
  d.sections
    ?.reasonForAdmission,
  d.sections
    ?.historyOfPresentIllness,
  d.sections
    ?.finalDiagnosis,
  d.sections
    ?.courseInWard
]
  .filter(Boolean)
  .join("\n\n");

return {
  json: {
    originalCase:
      d,

    aiRequest: {
      clinicalText,

      knownFacts: {
        isPregnancy:
          d.classification
            ?.isPregnancy ?? null,

        isGyne:
          d.classification
            ?.isGyne ?? null,

        isPostpartum:
          d.classification
            ?.isPostpartum ?? null,

        currentPregnancyDelivered:
          d.deliveryState
            ?.currentPregnancyDelivered
            ?? null,

        obscoreG:
          d.obstetric
            ?.gravida ?? null,

        obscoreP:
          d.obstetric
            ?.para ?? null,

        obscoreFT:
          d.obstetric
            ?.fullTerm ?? null,

        obscorePr:
          d.obstetric
            ?.preterm ?? null,

        obscoreAb:
          d.obstetric
            ?.abortion ?? null,

        obscoreLB:
          d.obstetric
            ?.living ?? null
      },

      unresolvedTerms:
        []
    }
  }
};
